text: 中国证监会就《私募投资母基金管理规定（征求意见稿）》公开征求意见。根据《私募条例》等监管要求，私募基金可以接受或者再投资一层私募基金等其他私募产品，接受投资的私募基金不得再投资其他私募产品，并明确对符合条件的母基金豁免计入一层投资层级。享受豁免的母基金应当持续符合相应条件，严格按照投资范围要求开展投资运作。私募基金管理人不得滥用投资层级豁免规定，规避监管要求。母基金确有必要直接、间接投资其他母基金或者接受其他母基金投资的，投资层级只能豁免一次。
text_en: The CSRC publicly solicited comments on the Provisions on the Administration of Private Investment Fund-of-Funds (Draft for Comment). In accordance with regulatory requirements such as the Private Investment Fund Regulations, private funds may accept or reinvest in one additional layer of private funds or other private products, and the private fund receiving the investment may not invest in other private products; qualified fund-of-funds are explicitly exempted from being counted as one investment layer. Fund-of-funds enjoying the exemption shall continuously meet the corresponding conditions and conduct investment operations strictly in accordance with the investment scope requirements. Private fund managers may not abuse the investment-layer exemption provisions to circumvent regulatory requirements. If a fund-of-funds truly needs to directly or indirectly invest in another fund-of-funds or accept investment from another fund-of-funds, the investment-layer exemption may only be granted once.
